tradingview.d: Twelve column sets: Overview, Performance, Technicals, Extended hours, Forecasts, Valuation, Dividends, Profitability, Income statement, Balance sheet, Cash flow, Per share. A reader finds a figure where the financial statements put it.

tradingview.t: Every financial column carries its period
tradingview.d: Fields are named by period (total_revenue_ttm, _fq for the fiscal quarter, _fh for the fiscal half, _fy for the year, price_earnings_current, dividend_amount_upcoming), and each screener column has a period selector: TTM, quarterly, semiannual, annual.
The _fh fields keep companies that report twice a year (foreign filers such as Rio Tinto) on a period they actually report, rather than a quarter they do not have.

tradingview.t: Forecasts are a set of their own
tradingview.d: Estimates (EPS, revenue, EBITDA, free cash flow, next twelve months) sit apart from reported figures, so a forward number is never read as a reported one.
Operating income, EBITDA and its margin, capex, ROIC, interest cover and per-share and per-employee versions sit beside the headline lines.

groups.name: Overview

groups.name: Signal

groups.name: Performance

groups.name: Technicals
groups.from: Trend, Range and level, Risk, side by side

groups.name: Valuation

groups.name: Income statement · TTM

groups.name: Profitability · TTM
